violated_contract: A diff-scoped guard that keys a computed call site by its site and expression treats the site as the unit of disclosure. When the collection family the site reads is a literal namespace tuple, adding a member changes the set of collections the site can reach without changing the key, so the guard reports nothing and a new unbudgeted read surface ships. The same shape applies to any guard that grandfathers a site while the dependency that determines its blast radius can still grow.
canonical_prevention: Compare the enumerable family, not only the site key, between the base revision and the change: resolve literal tuple/list sequences and the in-file bindings that draw from them, and require a reviewed budget or exemption for each member that first appears. Pin it with a fixture that holds the call site constant and expands the tuple, in both directions.
